title: Conversational Configurator for Batching & Cache
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Users configuring batching and KV/prefix caching in the Redwood Console frequently misestimate latency vs cost trade-offs and get overwhelmed by low-level knobs. Goal: Ship a lightweight conversational configurator inside the Console that guides engineers through a short, contextual flow to produce safe, cost-efficient batching+cache profiles. The flow should be skimmable for power users, friendly for engineers new to inference economics, and produce config objects compatible with runtime-1.18 profiles. Scope: dialogue-driven onboarding modal, inline recommendations panel on model route pages, explainers for each knob (max_batch_size, timeout_ms, prefix_cache_ttl, cache_key_strategy), and validation guardrails. Not in scope: changes to backend APIs or serving runtime behavior (handled by ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Conversational flow implemented as a modal and as an expandable side-panel on route settings
Prototype validated with at least 4 engineering customers and 2 Redwood PMs with qualitative sign-off
Generated config JSON matches the runtime config schema and includes human-readable rationales for each recommendation
Guardrails prevent values that would violate per-tenant latency SLOs in simulation mode
Design tokens and components follow Console design system and pass accessibility QC (WCAG AA)
decisions: Use a short question-answer conversational metaphor rather than a full wizard to reduce cognitive load
Deliver both a modal 'quick-config' and an inline side-panel for iterative adjustments
Expose an 'Advanced' toggle for all low-level knobs; high-level presets (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive) are recommended defaults
Recommendations are generated client-side using heuristics + small rule set provided by Research; we will not ship an on-device ML recommender in this phase
Show an estimated cost delta and 95th percentile simulated latency impact after the user answers 3-4 questions
review_notes: 2025-03-19 - PM review (Daniel Kim): Positive on conversational approach; requested explicit mention of 'rollback to previous profile' in modal
2025-03-21 - Eng feedback (Priya Nair): Needs an SDK/JSON output that matches ENG-3121 runtime schema; flagged edge case when model variant fallback is enabled
2025-03-22 - Accessibility review (Noah Rivera): Contrast issues on the info chips in low-light theme; suggested larger hit targets for toggles
2025-03-24 - Design critique (Team review): Suggest clarifying the 'cache key strategy' options with inline examples and adding a simulated token-cost graph
2025-03-25 - Legal/Security quick check (Marta Ruiz): No PII surfaced; recommended adding a tooltip that caching may persist prefixes in customer-managed buffers
decisions_log: 2025-03-20 - Chose not to auto-apply recommendations; require explicit user 'Apply' to avoid accidental cost changes
2025-03-23 - Agreed to include a 'Preview traffic simulation' button that runs a lightweight client-side evaluation using sampled route metrics
